svg.desc: Restoration of AL-MUNIRA Palace LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT French Institute of Oriental Archaeology COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2009 40 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview focuses on the refurbishment and renovation of Al-Munira Palace in Cairo. It involves comprehensive architectural and structural assessments, alongside the development of detailed design solutions to restore and enhance the building's historical and functional value. The scope of work also includes coordination with multidisciplinary teams, upgrading of building systems, and the preparation of tender and cost documentation for implementation.
